articles.summary: QueryPie has unveiled NotePie, an AI work assistant that answers questions based on user-specified documents and web sources, provides source information, and supports the creation of reports, slides, mind maps, podcasts, and other work outputs.
articles.title: QueryPie Unveils NotePie, an AI Work Assistant Based on Documents and Web Sources

articles.summary: QueryPie has achieved ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification for the AI management system applied to QueryPie AIP.
articles.title: QueryPie Achieves ISO/IEC 42001 Certification for Its AI Management System

articles.summary: QueryPie introduced Lingo, an AI real-time interpretation service that supports live captions and translation across in-person meetings, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom, then connects meeting summaries and follow-up work automation through QueryPie AI Platform.
articles.title: QueryPie unveils Lingo, an AI real-time interpretation service

articles.summary: QueryPie has unveiled AI Pack, an AI extension package that brings AI capabilities to its Access Control Platform, enabling natural language-driven management of enterprise infrastructure. In addition, QueryPie offers its Access Control Platform as an MCP, allowing AI agents to securely operate within existing access control policies.
articles.title: QueryPie Expands Its Access Control Platform with AI Capabilities
